cc:Work.dc:title: Who enters the top 10%?
cc:Work.dc:description: Public aggregate counts from Korobeinikova, Lvov and Pershin, Similar Scores, Different High-Risk Episodes. Raw history versus Era+backfill on EHRSHOT. Readmission: 185 shared, 34 representation-specific episodes in each primary top-decile set of 219. ICU transfer: 153 shared, 51 representation-specific episodes in each primary top-decile set of 204. Shares are within each set, not the union of both sets; they are not classification errors or performance gains. Source: https://github.com/LvovDmitro/ehrshot-state-or-space/blob/4a8dfe18a048a3baa6fc21a8f727bc40d3ca4959/paper/aggregate_outputs/ensemble_top10_cross_representation.csv
